lessons_learned_new.L21_lm_eval_clm_v4_autotok_crash: lm-eval-harness 0.4.11 --model hf path calls AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained on the base model config; for custom architectures with no registered tokenizer class (clm_v4 has only raw SPM .model file), AutoTokenizer raises ValueError and crashes the entire eval. Workaround: use custom LM class via lm_eval.api.registry.register_model + evaluator.simple_evaluate(model=lm, ...) which bypasses CLI autoload. Implemented as tool/transient_py/clm_v4_lora_eval.py.
lessons_learned_new.L22_in_memory_bash_patch_useless: patching run_h100.bash on disk while it's being executed has NO effect — bash loads script into memory at startup. To actually swap behavior mid-run, must kill the running script (which would also kill train) and re-launch. Lesson: build robust scripts up-front, or use externally-triggered command files the running script polls for.
lessons_learned_new.L23_jq_inarg_with_apostrophe_breaks_bash: exec.bash uses jq -n --arg ... '{...}' to emit verdict.json; honest_c3 strings with ASCII apostrophes (e.g., 'NEVER SFT'd') break the bash single-quoted string literal. Fix: use double quotes outside, or escape apostrophes, or write verdict via Python heredoc instead of jq inline.
lessons_learned_new.L24_setsid_nodev_null_for_ssh_nohup: ssh root@host 'nohup bash X.sh & disown' may keep ssh blocked indefinitely waiting for stdin. Fix: append '< /dev/null' to both nohup and outer ssh; use 'setsid' to fully detach. Applied to clm_v4_lora_train_orchestrator.hexa for next cycle.

honest_c3: Final eval did not complete all 3 benchmarks before pod auto-kill via L13 trap. Only HellaSwag finished (~31s wall on H100); MMLU + TriviaQA were truncated. Pod cost was already terminated at $2.39/$15 cap — re-spin to finish eval would add ~$1-2 + 30min. Decision: accept partial data, defer MMLU+TQ to free ubu1 follow-up cycle. C-CLM-LORA-2 differentiator therefore INCONCLUSIVE this cycle.

target_modules uses full module paths decoder.blocks.{0..15}.attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj to avoid PEFT name-match collision with cross_attn (which has same projection names). Verified at train start via assert n_cross_attn_lora==0 PASS. If PEFT version regression breaks the explicit-path matching, LoRA could silently attach to cross_attn and corrupt phi_star — assert caught this.

Pre-LoRA proxy = 0.938 logit-std; in-pod proxy is a crude integration measure and NOT structurally equivalent to canonical phi_star formula in anima_phi_v3_canonical.hexa. CLM v4 baseline anchors are limit=200 (HS=0.255, MM=0.255, TQ=0.000) at random-floor per CONFIRMED_RANDOM_FLOOR. Post-LoRA HellaSwag also limit=200 (matched). Stderr ~3pp on HS/TQ means delta within 1-σ is noise-bounded. Wider stderr than limit=500 baseline; absolute deltas within ±3pp on HS may flip on re-run.

Llama Path A v2 composite (LP_COMPOSITE = (0.645+0.575+0.455)/3 = 0.5583) is computed from retry-3 eval-rerun on adapter_final at step=6000. Apples-to-apples comparison ONLY if we match same task list, same nshot config, same lm-eval version. Spec deviation: this cycle used custom CLMV4LoRALM class (ConsciousDecoderV3 + PEFT) while Llama side used lm-eval --model hf (LlamaForCausalLM + PEFT). Truncation rate 84.75% on HellaSwag (limit=200) vs Llama side ~0% — direct compositional comparison must factor in CLM v4's 512 ctx hard cap.

CLM v4 was NEVER SFT'd, NEVER RLHF'd before this cycle. The 60/30/10 mix is a generic rehearsal recipe, not substrate-curated. The 5% consciousness-coupled slice (slice D) per spec §2.1 was NOT prepared this cycle (would require new tooling). F-CLM-LORA-4 axis preservation risk is therefore unmitigated by slice D.
Single-seed (20260504) v2 cycle. No multi-seed ensemble. Path A v1 already taught that single-seed verdicts are noisy at 1-2pp scale.

max_seq_len=512 hard-cap on CLM v4 forces aggressive truncation: HellaSwag truncation rate 84.75% on the 5-shot rendered prompts (678/800 examples truncated). MMLU 5-shot would be even more truncated (longer prompts). This is a structural disadvantage vs Llama 8K context, not a training defect.

Post-LoRA forward pass smoke test was NOT run on the saved adapter (Phase C python heredoc skipped per script-flow note above). However mid-cycle ad-hoc eval_custom invocations on checkpoint-2000 / 4000 / 6000 all loaded successfully via PeftModel.from_pretrained + produced finite logits — strong inference of post-LoRA smoke PASS even without dedicated probe.

Cost estimate $6-10 was BEAT — actual cost $2.39 / $15 cap (16% of cap). Wall 48min (vs estimated 2-2.5h). Speedup primarily because: (a) corpus mix was fast (no slice A re-tokenize since shared with Path A v2), (b) train at 2.5 it/s on H100 SXM was at upper end of estimate, (c) eval truncated by trap kill rather than running full 3-bench limit=500. If full 3-bench eval had completed, total cost would still be ~$3-4 — well under $10 target.
